meaning.en: the grandfather (Brahma)
meaning.hi: पितामह (ब्रह्मा)

meaning.en: approached his own father, the primal Narayana, and having bowed, asked
meaning.hi: अपने पिता आदिनारायण के पास जाकर, प्रणाम करके पूछा

meaning.en: the whole order of life-stage duties, already heard, known, and understood
meaning.hi: वर्णाश्रमधर्म का पूरा क्रम, सुना, ज्ञात और समझा हुआ

meaning.en: I wish to know the mark of a supreme wandering renunciant
meaning.hi: मैं परमहंसपरिव्राजक के लक्षण को जानना चाहता हूँ

meaning.en: who is qualified for the wandering life
meaning.hi: भ्रमण का अधिकारी कौन है

meaning.en: who is a paramahamsa, and how does one attain that wandering state
meaning.hi: परमहंस कौन है, परिव्राजकत्व कैसे होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: having become one who has, close to a true teacher, mastered every branch of learning
meaning.hi: सद्गुरु के निकट समस्त विद्याओं में परिश्रमी होकर

meaning.en: having understood all worldly and otherworldly pleasure as labor
meaning.hi: सांसारिक और परलोकिक सुख को श्रम जानकर

meaning.en: recognizing the three cravings, the sense of mine and I, as fit to be rejected like vomited food
meaning.hi: तीन एषणाओं, ममत्व-अहंकार को वमन किए अन्न के समान त्याज्य समझकर

meaning.en: understanding celibate discipline as the one means to liberation, one may complete it and become a householder
meaning.hi: मोक्षमार्ग का एकमात्र साधन ब्रह्मचर्य समझकर उसे पूर्ण कर गृहस्थ बने

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: from the household one may become a forest-dweller and then set out wandering
meaning.hi: गृह से वनी होकर प्रव्रजित हो

words.sanskrit: yadi vetaratha brahmacharyadeva pravrajet grihad va vanad va

meaning.en: or, otherwise, one may set out directly from celibate study, whether from home or forest
meaning.hi: अथवा सीधे ब्रह्मचर्य से ही, घर या वन से प्रव्रजित हो

meaning.en: the very day detachment arises, that very day one should set out
meaning.hi: जिस दिन विरक्ति हो उसी दिन प्रव्रजित हो

meaning.en: having sought the blessing of father, mother, spouse, children, and close kin
meaning.hi: माता-पिता, पत्नी-पुत्र, बंधुवर्ग की अनुमति लेकर

meaning.en: one should perform the rite in Agni's name alone
meaning.hi: अग्नि के नाम पर ही करे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: agnir hi pranah pranam evaitaya karoti

meaning.en: fire itself is the life-breath, and through it the life-breath acts
meaning.hi: अग्नि ही प्राण है, इसी से प्राण कार्य करता है

meaning.en: one should perform the threefold offering accordingly
meaning.hi: त्रैधातवीय कर्म करे

words.sanskrit: etayaiva trayo dhatavah sattvam rajastama iti

meaning.en: through this the three qualities -- sattva, rajas, tamas -- are set in motion
meaning.hi: इसी से तीनों धातु सत्त्व-रज-तम गतिमान होते हैं

words.sanskrit: ayam te yonir ritviyo yato jato arochathah

meaning.en: this is your proper source, from which you were kindled into being
meaning.hi: यह तुम्हारा उचित उद्गम है जिससे तुम प्रकट हुए

words.sanskrit: tam jannagna arohathano vardhaya rayim iti mantrena agnim ajighret

meaning.en: reciting the mantra asking for increase, one should breathe in the scent of the fire
meaning.hi: इस मंत्र से अग्नि की सुगंध ग्रहण करे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this is that very source of fire
meaning.hi: यही अग्नि का उद्गम है

words.sanskrit: yah pranam gaccha svam yonim gacchasva iti

meaning.en: go now to your own source, it says
meaning.hi: अपने उद्गम की ओर जाओ, ऐसा कहती है

meaning.en: having brought fire from the household of a learned village Brahmin
meaning.hi: गाँव के वेदज्ञ के घर से अग्नि लाकर

meaning.en: one should breathe in its scent exactly as prescribed, as before
meaning.hi: विहित विधि से पूर्ववत् अग्नि की सुगंध ग्रहण करे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yadyaturo va agnim na vinet apsu juhuyat

meaning.en: if too ill to manage fire, one should pour the offering into water instead
meaning.hi: यदि रोगी हो तो अग्नि के स्थान पर जल में आहुति दे

words.sanskrit: apo vai sarva devatah sarvabhyo devatabhyo juhomi svaha iti

meaning.en: all the waters are every deity; to all deities, this offering, so be it
meaning.hi: सभी जल ही समस्त देवता हैं, सबको यह आहुति, स्वाहा

meaning.en: having offered and drawn it back, one should sip it with a small clarified-butter-touched offering
meaning.hi: अर्पित कर जल उठाकर घी सहित अल्प हविष्य पिए

words.sanskrit: eshah vidhih viradhvane va anashake va agnipraveshe va mahaprasthane va

meaning.en: this same rule applies on the hard path, in fasting to death, entering fire, or the great final journey
meaning.hi: यही विधि कठोर मार्ग, अनशन, अग्निप्रवेश या महाप्रस्थान में लागू होती है

words.sanskrit: manasa vacha va sannyaset esha panthah

meaning.en: one may renounce through mind or speech alone; that too is a valid path
meaning.hi: मन या वाणी से भी संन्यास लिया जा सकता है, यह भी मार्ग है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: svasthakrameneva chet atmashraddham virajahomam kritva agnim atmani aropya

meaning.en: if in the fuller healthy path, one performs the rite for one's own well-being and places the fire within oneself
meaning.hi: स्वस्थ क्रम से आत्मश्राद्ध कर अग्नि को आत्मा में आरोपित करे

meaning.en: entrusting the fourteen inner faculties to the son
meaning.hi: चौदह करणों की प्रवृत्ति पुत्र को सौंपकर

words.sanskrit: brahma tvam yajnastvam iti abhimantrya brahmabhavanaya dhyatva

meaning.en: reciting 'you are Brahman, you are the sacrifice' and meditating with the feeling of Brahman
meaning.hi: 'तुम ब्रह्म हो, तुम यज्ञ हो' कहकर ब्रह्मभावना से ध्यान करे

meaning.en: dissolving the Veda, the mother of learning, into the three sacred utterances
meaning.hi: वेदमाता को तीन व्याहृतियों में विलीन करे

words.sanskrit: shikham utkrishya yajnopavitam chittva vastram api bhumau va apsu va visrijya

meaning.en: drawing up the topknot, cutting the sacred thread, and setting aside the garment on ground or water
meaning.hi: शिखा उठाकर, यज्ञोपवीत काटकर, वस्त्र को भूमि या जल में त्यागकर

meaning.en: having become like one newly born, meditating on one's own true form
meaning.hi: नवजात के समान होकर अपने स्वरूप का ध्यान करे

words.sanskrit: sannyastam maya sannyastam maya sannyastam mayeti trivaram

meaning.en: reciting three times, 'I have renounced, I have renounced, I have renounced'
meaning.hi: 'मैंने संन्यास लिया' तीन बार उच्चारण करे

words.sanskrit: abhayam sarvabhutebhyo mattah svaha iti urdhvabahurbhutva

meaning.en: with arms raised, declaring fearlessness to all beings from oneself
meaning.hi: भुजाएँ उठाकर सब प्राणियों को अभयदान की घोषणा करे

words.sanskrit: tattvamasi adivakyartham anusandhanam kurvan udichim disham gacchet

meaning.en: contemplating the meaning of 'that thou art' and the like, one should walk north
meaning.hi: 'तत् त्वम् असि' आदि महावाक्यों का चिंतन करते हुए उत्तर दिशा को जाए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: newly born in this way, one should wander freely
meaning.hi: नवजात के समान भ्रमण करे

meaning.en: this alone is true renunciation
meaning.hi: यही संन्यास है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tadadhikari na bhavet yadi grihasthaprarthanapurvakam abhayam sarvabhutebhyah mattah

meaning.en: should one not yet be fit for this, one performs the household version, calling fearlessness from every being through devotion to me
meaning.hi: अयोग्य हो तो गृहस्थ-विधि से अभयदान का आह्वान करे

words.sanskrit: vainavam dandam katisutram kaupinam kamandalum vivarnavastram ekam parigrihya

meaning.en: taking up the staff, waist-cord, loincloth, water-pot, and a single plain garment
meaning.hi: दण्ड, कटिसूत्र, कौपीन, कमण्डलु और एक सादा वस्त्र लेकर

words.sanskrit: sadgurum upagamya natva gurumukhat tattvamasi iti mahavakyam upalabhya

meaning.en: approaching a true teacher, bowing, and receiving the great teaching 'that thou art' from the teacher's mouth
meaning.hi: सद्गुरु के पास जाकर प्रणाम कर गुरुमुख से 'तत् त्वम् असि' महावाक्य प्राप्त करे

meaning.en: having set aside desire, anger, greed, delusion, pride, envy, arrogance, ambition, longing, hatred, elation, resentment, and possessiveness
meaning.hi: काम-क्रोध-लोभ-मोह-मद-मत्सर आदि दुर्गुणों को त्यागकर

meaning.en: such a one draws near to the very state of Brahman
meaning.hi: ऐसा व्यक्ति ब्रह्मभाव के निकट पहुँचता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: treating gain and loss alike at all times
meaning.hi: सदा लाभ-हानि को समान समझकर

words.sanskrit: parapatramadhukarena annam ashnan medovriddhim akurvan krishibhutva

meaning.en: eating alms without craving richness, keeping the body lean rather than heavy
meaning.hi: भिक्षा का अन्न खाते हुए शरीर को कृश रखे

meaning.en: wandering alone for eight months, with a companion for two more
meaning.hi: आठ माह अकेले, दो माह साथी सहित भ्रमण करे

words.sanskrit: kutichako va bahudako va hamso va paramahamso va

meaning.en: one may become a hut-dweller, a wanderer among waters, a swan, or a supreme swan
meaning.hi: कुटीचक, बहूदक, हंस या परमहंस बने

words.sanskrit: katisutram kaupinam dandam kamandalum sarvam apsu visrijya jataruparah charet

meaning.en: offering the waist-cord, loincloth, staff, and water-pot into water, one wanders newly born
meaning.hi: कटिसूत्र, कौपीन, दण्ड, कमण्डलु जल में त्यागकर नवजात-सा भ्रमण करे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: grama ekaratram tirthe triratram pattane panicharatram kshetre saptaratram aniketah

meaning.en: one night in a village, three at a sacred crossing, five in a town, seven in a holy district, never settling
meaning.hi: गाँव में एक रात, तीर्थ में तीन, नगर में पाँच, क्षेत्र में सात, अनिकेत

meaning.en: steady of mind, keeping no fire, unchanging
meaning.hi: स्थिरमति, अग्निसेवारहित, निर्विकार

meaning.en: begging in the manner of a cow grazing wherever it finds itself
meaning.hi: गोवृत्ति से भिक्षाचरण करते हुए

meaning.en: devoted to uprooting good and bad action alike, sleeping wherever bare ground offers itself
meaning.hi: शुभ-अशुभ कर्म को उखाड़ने में तत्पर, भूमि पर शयन करते हुए

meaning.en: behaving as though slightly mad without real madness, without fixed mark or fixed pattern
meaning.hi: बिना पागलपन के पागल-सा आचरण, चिह्नरहित, अव्यक्त-आचार

meaning.en: treating day and night alike, beyond sleep
meaning.hi: दिन-रात को समान समझकर, निद्रारहित

words.sanskrit: sannyasena dehatyagam karoti sa paramahamsaparivrajako bhavati

meaning.en: giving up the body through renunciation, such a one becomes a supreme wandering swan
meaning.hi: संन्यास से देहत्याग करता हुआ परमहंसपरिव्राजक होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: bhagavan brahmapranavah kidrisha iti brahma prichchhati

meaning.en: Brahma asked: revered one, what is the nature of the Brahman-syllable
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा ने पूछा, ब्रह्मप्रणव कैसा है

meaning.en: the Brahman-syllable is made of sixteen fine measures
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मप्रणव सोलह मात्राओं से युक्त है

meaning.en: it extends across four states, each unfolding into a further four
meaning.hi: यह चार अवस्थाओं में, हर एक चार में विभाजित

meaning.en: in the waking state, four sub-states rooted in waking
meaning.hi: जाग्रत अवस्था में जाग्रत की चार उप-अवस्थाएँ

words.sanskrit: svapne svapnadi chatasro'vasthah suptau suptyadi chatasro'vasthah turiye turiyadi chatasro'vasthah

meaning.en: likewise four each rooted in dream, in deep sleep, and in the transcendent state
meaning.hi: स्वप्न, सुषुप्ति और तुरीय में भी चार-चार उप-अवस्थाएँ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: in the waking state, the fourfold nature of the universal aspect
meaning.hi: जाग्रत अवस्था में विश्व की चार-गुना प्रकृति

meaning.en: ordinary-within-ordinary, luminous-within-ordinary, wise-within-ordinary, transcendent-within-ordinary
meaning.hi: विश्व-विश्व, विश्व-तैजस, विश्व-प्राज्ञ, विश्व-तुरीय

meaning.en: in the dream state, the fourfold nature of the luminous aspect
meaning.hi: स्वप्न अवस्था में तैजस की चार-गुना प्रकृति

meaning.en: in deep sleep, the fourfold nature of the wise aspect
meaning.hi: सुषुप्ति में प्राज्ञ की चार-गुना प्रकृति

meaning.en: in the transcendent state, the fourfold nature of the transcendent itself
meaning.hi: तुरीय अवस्था में तुरीय की चार-गुना प्रकृति

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: akare jagradvishva ukare jagrattaijaso makare jagratprajna ardhamatrayam jagraturiyo

meaning.en: in A rests waking-within-waking, in U luminous-within-waking, in M wise-within-waking, in the half-measure transcendent-within-waking
meaning.hi: अकार, उकार, मकार, अर्धमात्रा में जाग्रत की चार अवस्थाएँ

words.sanskrit: bindau svapnavishvo nade svapnataijasah kalayam svapnaprajnah kalatite svapnaturiyah

meaning.en: in bindu, nada, kala, kalatita rest the four dream states
meaning.hi: बिन्दु, नाद, कला, कलातीत में स्वप्न की चार अवस्थाएँ

words.sanskrit: shantau sushuptavishvah shantyatite sushuptataijasa unmanyam sushuptaprajno manonmanyam sushuptaturiyah

meaning.en: in shanti, shantyatita, unmani, manonmani rest the four deep-sleep states
meaning.hi: शान्ति, शान्त्यतीत, उन्मनी, मनोन्मनी में सुषुप्ति की चार अवस्थाएँ

words.sanskrit: puryam turiyavisho madhyamayam turiyataijasah pashyantam turiyaprajnah parayam turiyaturiyah

meaning.en: in puri, madhyama, pashyanti, para rest the four transcendent states
meaning.hi: पुरी, मध्यमा, पश्यन्ती, परा में तुरीय की चार अवस्थाएँ

meaning.en: the four measures of each state form the A, U, M, and half-measure portions respectively
meaning.hi: जाग्रत, स्वप्न, सुषुप्ति, तुरीय की चार मात्राएँ क्रमशः अ, उ, म, अर्धमात्रा अंश बनाती हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this itself is the true Brahman-syllable
meaning.hi: यही सच्चा ब्रह्मप्रणव है

meaning.en: it should be worshipped by supreme swans and those beyond the transcendent state
meaning.hi: परमहंस और तुरीयातीत अवधूतों द्वारा उपास्य

meaning.en: through this alone Brahman shines forth and liberation while embodied comes
meaning.hi: इसी से ब्रह्म प्रकाशित होता है, इसी से जीवन्मुक्ति

words.sanskrit: kathamayajnopavityashikhi sarvakarmaparityaktah kathambrahmanishthaparah katham brahmana iti brahma prichchhati

meaning.en: how does one without thread or topknot, having set aside all ritual duty, come to be a true Brahmin
meaning.hi: बिना यज्ञोपवीत-शिखा के, कर्मत्यागी, ब्राह्मण कैसे कहलाता है, ब्रह्मा पूछते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Lord Vishnu answered: listen, child
meaning.hi: विष्णु ने कहा, सुनो बालक

meaning.en: for one who holds non-dual self-knowledge, that knowledge is itself the sacred thread
meaning.hi: जिसका अद्वैत आत्मज्ञान है वही यज्ञोपवीत है

meaning.en: steady absorption in meditation is itself the topknot
meaning.hi: ध्याननिष्ठा ही शिखा है

meaning.en: that very knowledge is the pure act, and such a one performs every true action
meaning.hi: वह कर्म ही पवित्र है, वह सर्वकर्मकर्ता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sa brahmanah sa brahmanishthaparah sa devah sa rishih sa tapasvi sa shreshthah

meaning.en: such a one is Brahmin, established in Brahman, deity, seer, ascetic, finest of all
meaning.hi: वह ब्राह्मण, ब्रह्मनिष्ठ, देव, ऋषि, तपस्वी, श्रेष्ठ है

words.sanskrit: sa eva sarvajyeshthah sa eva jagadguruh sa eva aham viddhi

meaning.en: such a one is the very eldest, the teacher of the world; know such a one to be Myself
meaning.hi: वही सर्वज्येष्ठ, जगद्गुरु है, उसे मुझे ही जानो

meaning.en: in this world a true paramahamsaparivrajaka is exceedingly rare, if even one exists
meaning.hi: संसार में परमहंसपरिव्राजक अत्यंत दुर्लभ है, यदि एक भी हो

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: such a one is ever pure
meaning.hi: वह सदा पवित्र है

words.sanskrit: sa eva vedapurusho mahapurusho yastachchittam mayyeva avatishthate

meaning.en: such a one is the person the Veda points to, whose mind rests wholly in Me
meaning.hi: वह वेदपुरुष, महापुरुष है, जिसका चित्त मुझमें ही स्थित है

meaning.en: and I too rest wholly in that very person
meaning.hi: और मैं भी उसी में स्थित हूँ

meaning.en: such a one is free of cold and heat, pleasure and pain, honor and dishonor
meaning.hi: वह शीत-उष्ण, सुख-दुःख, मान-अपमान से मुक्त है

meaning.en: such a one is free of the six waves and empty of the six changes of a living being
meaning.hi: वह छह ऊर्मियों और छह भावविकारों से मुक्त है

meaning.en: such a one recognizes no barrier between the highest and the least
meaning.hi: वह ज्येष्ठ-अज्येष्ठ के व्यवधान से रहित है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: such a one sees no other apart from their own self
meaning.hi: वह अपनी आत्मा के अतिरिक्त किसी और को नहीं देखता

words.sanskrit: na namaskaro na svahakaro na svadhakaro na nindastutivyatiriktah

meaning.en: no bowing, no ritual cry of offering, no formula of ancestral rite, untouched by blame or praise
meaning.hi: न नमस्कार, न स्वाहाकार, न स्वधाकार, निंदा-स्तुति से परे

meaning.en: no devotee of mantra or ritual technique, empty of meditation on lesser deities, turned from every goal seen or unseen, settled beyond all
meaning.hi: मंत्र-तंत्र का उपासक नहीं, देवांतर-ध्यान-शून्य, लक्ष्य-अलक्ष्य से निवृत्त, सर्वोपरत

meaning.en: whole in truth, consciousness, and bliss without a second, complete in a single undivided awareness of joy
meaning.hi: सच्चिदानन्द-अद्वय-चिद्घन, सम्पूर्णानन्द-एकबोध

words.sanskrit: brahmaivaham asmi iti anavaratam brahmapranavanusandhanena yah kritakrityo bhavati sa ha paramahamsaparivrat iti upanishat

meaning.en: through unbroken absorption in 'I am Brahman,' whoever becomes accomplished is truly the paramahamsaparivrajaka; so declares this Upanishad
meaning.hi: 'मैं ब्रह्म हूँ' के अटूट अनुसंधान से जो कृतकृत्य होता है वही परमहंसपरिव्राजक है, ऐसा उपनिषद् कहता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
